officialAuthority: LEGO official building instructions and completed source model
targetImageRole: Scan of official LEGO instruction page 68 showing the completed flight model and its three-leg walker conversion in one source composition. The scan is hosted by a third party; the linked LEGO-hosted PDF is the source authority.

independentCompletedModelCrossCheck.role: Independent close-up of assembled LEGO 7646 flight configuration; supports proportions, actual LEGO construction language and color/print read.

sourceFindings: The completed flight model has a long split central nose, an exposed crew/core deck, two independently built curved side modules, red weapon tips and flexible lime conduits.
Official instructions build both side modules separately and attach them to the central craft.
Official instruction page 68 shows those same two side modules and the long forward hull rotated down into exactly three planted walker members.
No extra spider legs or alternate chassis are part of the source conversion.
evidenceLimits: Available independent assembled-model photography confirms the flight state; the official final transformation page is the direct visual evidence for the completed walker state.
The source does not define continuous gait, gameplay weapon timing or detector-sweep timing; those are not visual geometry decisions in this package.
